text: Specifies the conditions for physical admittance to a general meeting.
Define specific rights that the shareholder has (for example, the right to ask questions, the right to add items to the agenda or table draft resolutions).
Indicates that the assignment of a proxy is not allowed for the meeting.
Date is specified as a fixed code value.
Specifies a status for a meeting date.
Specifies the role of the Issuer agent.
Specifies the impact of a vote on an agenda resolution in general meetings.
Specifies whether a resolution in an agenda is still active or has been deleted.
Specifies a type of voting instruction that can be part of a recommendation to vote.
Nature of the quantity used as a basis to set a threshold for voting on resolutions at general meetings.
Specifies the network channel through which the vote should be sent.
Indicates the legal constraint on the Power of Attorney.
